notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats.
